subject: On-site demo next week — convert to recorded run‑through?
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Susan Giles <susan.giles@orbitalmed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T16:05:00Z
Subject: On-site demo next week — draft agenda & logistics

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for taking time to meet with us next week. Per our call, I’m locking in an on‑site demo for Dec 6 at 10:00 AM local at your HQ. Attached is a short agenda (demo‑agenda.pdf) and a calendar invite (travel‑itinerary.ics) for your team.

High‑level plan:
- 10:00–10:10: quick intros and goals
- 10:10–10:40: product run‑through (live inference, routing and cost controls)
- 10:40–11:00: Q&A + next steps (pilot timeline / security)

If anything in the agenda looks off, tell me and we’ll update. Monica (cc’d) will join as the technical lead and handle deeper infra/security questions.

Also, if travel is tight we can convert the live session to a short recorded run‑through with a 30‑minute follow‑up Q&A — that’s often easier when schedules conflict. Wanted to flag that as an option so we don’t lose momentum.

Next steps: please confirm the on‑site time or let us know if you prefer the recorded option and an alternate preferred time for the follow‑up.

Thanks,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
+1 415‑555‑0123

Attachments: demo‑agenda.pdf, travel‑itinerary.ics
From: Susan Giles <susan.giles@orbitalmed.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@orbitalmed.com
Date: 2026-11-29T18:20:00Z
Subject: Re: On-site demo next week — draft agenda & logistics

Hi Maya,

Appreciate the agenda — looks solid. Unfortunately we’ve had an unexpected extension of a field audit that will keep our director and two engineers on site through the week of Dec 6. That means the original on‑site window won’t work for the stakeholders who need to be present.

Options from our side:
1) Can you convert the run‑through to a recorded demo (short, ~20 minutes) that our team can watch asynchronously, followed by a 30‑minute live Q&A the week after (Dec 9–11)?
2) If you must do a live session the week of Dec 6, we’d need to push to the afternoon or have a reduced audience (no director). Not ideal.

We’d prefer option 1 so the director can review the recording on their schedule. If you can provide a recorded version and a runbook for evaluation, we’ll follow up with time for Q&A.

Thanks —
Susan Giles
Director, Clinical Ops | OrbitalMed
susan.giles@orbitalmed.com
+1 617‑555‑8873

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Susan Giles <susan.giles@orbitalmed.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T19:12:00Z
Subject: Re: On-site demo next week — draft agenda & logistics

Hi Susan / Maya —

Thanks for the heads up, Susan. Converting to a recorded run‑through is straightforward and we can have a concise, focused artifact ready quickly. Proposed approach:

- Short recorded session (~18–22 minutes) that follows the agenda you received: high‑level, demo of routing/fallbacks, quick cost/latency dashboard walkthrough.
- A one‑page runbook (demo‑runbook.pdf) attached with expected acceptance criteria for a pilot (e.g., throughput targets, privacy controls to validate).
- Optional sandbox access so your engineers can poke at a small dataset asynchronously; we can provision that before the Q&A.
- Live 30‑minute Q&A the week of Dec 9 — propose Dec 9 at 11:00 AM ET (we can slot another time if that doesn’t work).

If that sounds good we’ll:
1) Produce the video file (recorded-demo-offer.mp4) and upload to a secure share.
2) Send the runbook and provision sandbox creds.
3) Book the 30‑minute Q&A on Dec 9 at 11:00 AM ET — tentatively hold on everyone’s calendar until you confirm.

Monica — can you own the runbook and sandbox provisioning? I’ll handle the recording and recording notes.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Susan —

This plan works well. We’ll convert the planned on‑site to a recorded run‑through and set up the follow‑up Q&A. Action items for us (so we’re explicit):

1) Redwood to deliver recorded demo (recorded-demo-offer.mp4) and demo runbook (demo‑runbook.pdf) by Dec 2 COB.
2) Redwood to provision sandbox access and send creds by Dec 3.
3) Tentative 30‑minute follow‑up Q&A: Dec 9, 11:00 AM ET — Maya to send calendar hold pending your confirmation.

Monica will own the runbook and sandbox steps; Karthik will produce the recording. I’ll send the calendar hold and upload links to the secure share and HubSpot deal record.

If anything changes on your end, I’m happy to re‑open scheduling. Thanks for the quick update — we’ll keep this tight so you can review before the director returns.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
